fusions.name: Cast Mesh
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Spun Strands
fusions.desc: Looses 3 strands at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Bait Drop
fusions.desc: A lure that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Basin Catch
fusions.desc: When a condition on you ends, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
